scope: Bounded Phase 2 CI-only acceptance addendum. No Linux PASS, final merge acceptance, new production-source qualification, or later-phase acceptance is claimed.

source_equivalence.statement: Production code, tests, configurations, dependencies, lock and submodule gitlinks are identical from fully qualified local 204082 through evidence descendant 9ee92 to candidate ae3d. Only the listed workflow/helper/receipt differ in this CI change.

accepted_ci_contract.test_command_and_assertion_preservation: Verified in the bounded workflow diff; no coverage or runtime assertion relaxation and no continue-on-error.
accepted_ci_contract.artifact_selection: Top-level and runtime evidence including actual payloads/checkpoints retained; symlink aliases and special files excluded without following them; reproducible unit fixtures and unit diagnostics above 1 MiB excluded with manifest accounting.
accepted_ci_contract.collection_failure: Actual CLI returns nonzero on read issues and missing source. Successful prior qualification adds --require-complete and fails for missing required records. Already failed/cancelled qualification permits expected partial records. Manifest is written before these exits, and upload uses always().
accepted_ci_contract.validation_basis: Fresh independent review verifies real CLI negative cases, exact workflow shell branches, runtime retention, downloaded failed-Linux fixture, hashes, syntax, import ordering, formatting and helper typing. This gate verifies review/source hashes and reviews the bounded diff; it does not duplicate the full suites.

prior_local_acceptance.interpretation: Prior audited Mac qualification remains valid for unchanged production/tests/lock. No gratuitous full Mac rerun is required for this CI-only amendment. Historical Python 3.14 results remain evidence, not a requirement to restore Python 3.14 CI.

superseded_requirements: The user-authorized Python 3.13-only hosted scope supersedes Python 3.13/3.14 Linux wording in earlier gates/local acceptance. New finite budgets supersede the earlier 20-minute base/mandatory and 90-minute job budgets; runtime budget and assertions are preserved.

initial_linux_run.facts: Original mandatory step reached 20-minute timeout; base took approximately 18:02 on Python 3.13 and 19:02 on Python 3.14. Artifact alias ENOENT was observed. Partial logs are regression fixtures and do not establish Linux PASS.

authorization.condition: Record resulting commit/tree and verify exact candidate non-evidence content after integration; evidence-only overlays are permitted. Merge remains contingent on actual successful exact-source Linux qualification and its audit.

pending_checks: Run exact integrated source on hosted Ubuntu Python 3.13 with base, mandatory initialized suite, runtime and quality steps all successful within finite budgets.
Audit actual test inventories, documented skips/notices, runtime natural completion/failure containment and no survivors; do not infer pass from staging.
Verify uploaded provenance, expected records and artifact-selection manifest with retained runtime payload/checkpoint evidence, plus actual staging/upload success.
Record hosted commit/tree mapping, run URL, timing and result receipts; finalize PR and Phase 2 delivery only after audited hosted PASS.
review_method: Read-only repositories; reviewed CI diff/helper and original gate/local acceptance; independently bound HEAD/tree/cleanliness, exact changed-path scope, local-source equivalence and fresh review/source evidence hashes. Wrote only this requested /tmp gate. No nested agents, source edits, commits, installs, broad suite reruns, hosted actions or unrelated LLM-retirement review.
